theorem: Pauli-twirling any CPTP recovery preserves entanglement fidelity against a Pauli channel and produces a Pauli recovery channel. The remaining objective is linear in its four probabilities, so an optimal recovery is a Pauli unitary correcting a most likely error. For probabilities (1/10,3/10,3/10,3/10), the Bloch determinant is negative and the global optimum over all, including nonunital, CPTP recoveries is 3/10, attained by X, Y, or Z correction.
